dct_title_s: City of Minneapolis residential paving program, 1983-1988
dct_alternative_sm: City of Minneapolis residential paving program, 1983-1988
dct_description_sm: Map shows residential neighborhoods of Minneapolis with dates indicating completion of paving, as early as 1953. Those neighborhoods paved between 1983-1988 are listed and numbered in the map legend, with hand coloring coded by year.; In ink at upper right corner: "P. Daugherty".; In ink on verso: "739".
